# The Exchange test expectation preserves the mock HTTP EWS endpoint

The focused follow-up corrects a discovered EWS URL expectation from HTTPS to the HTTP endpoint supplied by the test XML. The separate autodiscovery setup uses HTTPS and an Authorization check. The accepted test later uses serviceURL and a line-specific sdl/no-insecure-url comment while retaining the HTTP expected value. This is a test-fixture contract and directive-version observation, not permission for insecure production endpoints or proof of a fresh lint/formatter pass.

Scope: Account Hub Exchange test fixture and lint exception.
